info.title: Serialized Data API
info.description: On-chain data for trading apps - tokens, candles, token filters. Built on our own indexers. 18 EVM chains + Solana, live.

get.description: Chains covered by the audit engine.

Full Serialized Audit verdict for a contract: safety verdict, vulnerabilities, ownership/renounce state, proxy detection, open-source status. Async-first: an already-audited token answers inline; a new one starts the audit and returns a progress status to re-poll.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id - `evm:<id>` (audit covers EVM only).

get.description: Supported chains with status. Free.

Static definition of one market (pool): venue/type, launchpad/factory of origin, fee tier (bps), base & quote token metadata, price, liquidity, launchpad + bonding state, created-at. Slow-changing, cache-friendly. A market id is simply chain + pool address: stable, unique on its venue, never reused.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

get.description: Live snapshot of one market, safe to poll at high frequency: price (native + USD), liquidity, market cap, circulating + total supply, and per-window volume, buy/sell counts and volumes, unique traders, fees and price change (5m / 1h / 24h). One call per market poll.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

get.description: Historical OHLCV for one market, addressed by pool. Same engine, intervals (1s to 1M) and candle shape as `/v1/token/ohlcv` - here the pool IS the market (no curve stitching, no aggregation), for exact per-market charts.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported; Solana base58, case-sensitive).

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix seconds, inclusive upper bound. Paginate back with prev `meta.oldestTime - 1` while `meta.hasMore` (or with `meta.nextEndTime` when present).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Window start (unix SECONDS, inclusive - candle timestamps are TradingView-style seconds).

parameters.name: fill
parameters.description: Gap-fill empty buckets with flat candles for a dense time axis (default `false`).

get.description: Ranked traders of a single market (pool) over a rolling window: net native PnL, tokens and native bought/sold, open position, average entry, first/last trade, and dev/sniper/pro-trader badges. Same engine as token top traders, scoped to one pool.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported).

get.description: Trade tape of one market, addressed by pool: recent + historical, time-bounded, opaque cursor pagination, optional participant filter. Same row shape and filters as `/v1/token/trades` - a page here equals `/v1/token/trades?pools=<this pool>`.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Pool / pair address (the stable market id on its chain - Uniswap V4 poolIds supported; Solana base58, case-sensitive).

parameters.name: maker
parameters.description: Filter trades by a single participant address.

parameters.name: usdMin
parameters.description: Keep trades whose USD volume is at least this (also `usdMax`, `nativeMin`, `nativeMax`, `tokenAmountMin`, `tokenAmountMax`).

parameters.name: fromAt
parameters.description: Only trades at/after this time (epoch ms, inclusive). `toAt` bounds the other end.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque - pass `meta.nextCursor` back verbatim to page.

post.description: Live snapshot of up to 100 markets in one call - the whole market-poll fan-out in a single request. Per-market shape identical to /v1/pool/data. Response is in input order, unknown markets slot in as null. Billed per market.

markets.description: Up to 100 of `{chain, address}`. Response array is in input order; an unknown market is `null`. Billed per market.

post.description: Small native-price arrays for list rows - one call for up to 100 markets, cross-chain, keyed by pool. Timeframes 1m|5m|30m|1h|24h|7d. Missing pools return [] - we never invent data.

markets.description: List of `{chain, address}` pools (up to 100 per call, cross-chain). Billing is per market; a missing pool returns `[]`.

post.description: The tape of up to 200 markets in a single call, since a timestamp - grouped per market, with a per-market row cap. One request replaces a full polling fan-out. Cross-chain; billed per market.

markets.description: List of `{chain, address}` pools (up to 200 per call, cross-chain). Billing is per market.

from.description: Only trades at/after this time (epoch ms, inclusive) - at most 24h back.

get.description: Live USD prices of every chain's native coin, with per-symbol freshness (`updatedAt`, `stale`) - you always know how fresh a price is.

Axiom-style launchpad lifecycle columns: `new` (created under 24h), `bonding` (active curves, sorted by bonding %), `graduated` (migrated or virtually-graduated, last 7 days). ~90 launchpads tracked natively across 18 EVM chains, bonding thresholds per factory.

parameters.name: chains
parameters.description: CSV of chain ids (≤8), EVM and Solana mixable.

get.description: Every tradable market, paginated: filters by chain and token, sort by volume, market cap or creation time, cursor pagination. The discovery primitive - poll it to detect new markets.

parameters.name: chains
parameters.description: CSV of public chain ids (1-8). sortBy=createdAt serves ONE chain per call (indexed walk) - fan out per chain.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: `volume` (default), `marketCap` or `createdAt`. volume/marketCap rank within the top-1000-by-24h-volume universe (`meta.universe`).

get.description: Low-latency token search: exact address (EVM hex, Solana base58, pool addresses) or free-text name/symbol (trigram). Covers BOTH families: `chain=solana` or `chain=evm:<id>` restricts; no chain searches EVM and Solana in parallel and merges by USD liquidity. Results carry price, liquidity, market cap, 24h volume and 1h/24h price change.

post.description: Full-detail batch twin: up to 25 `{chain, address}` items (EVM and Solana can be mixed in one call), response array in input order with per-item `{error}` slots. Billed per item.

get.description: Full token snapshot: price (native + USD), market cap & FDV (sanity-capped), liquidity (+ATH), best pool (canonical priority ranking), launchpad state (bonding progress, graduation), deployer, 24h stats, metadata & socials.

Every token deployed by a wallet, with a verdict on each (`active`, `migrated`, `rugged`, `abandoned`) and an aggregate risk read on the deployer: totals per status, graduation success rate, risk level, first and last deploy. Pass `address` to evaluate the deployer BEHIND a token (we resolve it), or `wallet` to query a deployer directly.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address - its deployer is resolved first. Required unless `wallet` is given.

get.description: Top holders with position size, share of supply, full PnL (realized + unrealized), buy/sell volumes, behavioral labels and named entities (exchanges, funds - the "Coinbase" signal). EVM and Solana.
Socials, description, images, dex-paid status. POST twin on the same path for batches (≤100, billed per item).

Chart-ready candles from 1s to 1M. Token-wide by default (the pool we price the token from, tracked across a bonding-curve migration and stitched into one continuous series), or aggregate an explicit set of up to 50 pools. Wick-outlier clamping and candle connecting included. On Base, the forming candle folds preconfirmed (flashblocks) swaps ~2.5s before block commit.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58, case-sensitive).

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Optional. CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to aggregate. Omit for the token-wide default (best pool, tracked across migration, curve history stitched in). Each pool listed must belong to the token.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Unix seconds, inclusive upper bound. Paginate back with prev `meta.oldestTime - 1` while `meta.hasMore` (or with `meta.nextEndTime` when present).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unix seconds, inclusive lower bound - scans stop there.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: `native` (default) or `usd` (Solana) - `usd` converts each candle at its bucket's SOL/USD rate from our in-house minute-grade price history.

parameters.name: fill
parameters.description: Gap-fill empty buckets with flat candles for a dense time axis (default `false`).

get.description: Every market of a token, ranked by our canonical pool priority - rank 1 is the exact pool the token endpoint prices from.

post.description: Batch twin - up to 100 tokens in one call, one SQL round-trip. Response in input order; missing tokens come back as per-item `{error}` slots.

get.description: Cheap price tier for bots and tickers: price, market cap, liquidity. Nothing else.

post.description: Security fields for up to 500 tokens in one call, one union shape across EVM and Solana: mint/freeze authority state, holders count, top-10 concentration, dev/sniper/bundler holdings %, token burn, LP burn/lock, buy/sell/transfer tax, dexPaid + dexPaidAt. Billed per item. null always means unknown, never a fake zero.

items.description: Up to 500 of `{chain, address}`. Response array is in input order with per-item `{error}` slots. Billed per item.

get.description: Security fields for any token in one union shape: mint/freeze authority state, holders count, top-10 concentration (CEX-custody excluded), dev/sniper/bundler holdings %, token burn, LP burn/lock, buy/sell/transfer tax, and dexPaid + dexPaidAt. EVM and Solana. null always means unknown, never a fake zero.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (base58 mint on Solana, case-sensitive; `0x…` on EVM).

post.description: Small native-price arrays for token list rows - one call for up to 100 tokens on a chain. We resolve each token's best pool (curve history stitched in) and return one line per token. Timeframes 1m|5m|30m|1h|24h|7d. Unknown tokens return [] - we never invent data.

tokens.description: Token addresses (up to 100, same chain). Billing is per token; an unknown token returns `[]`.

get.description: Windowed volume, buy/sell counts and volumes, transactions and price change - 5m/1h/6h/24h in one call. Token-wide across every pool by default.

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: CSV of pool addresses (≤50) to scope the stats to specific markets. **Omit for token-wide stats across every pool** - the default, and what a single token figure should be. Every pool passed must belong to the token, or the request is rejected with 400.

get.description: Ranked traders of a token from our own PnL fold: realized PnL in native and USD, tokens and native bought/sold, open position, average entry, win rate over closed positions, first/last trade, and dev/sniper/pro-trader badges. Lifetime by default, or any rolling window (1h → 30d).

Real-time trade tape, token-wide by default or restricted to specific pools. `maker` is the REAL trader (relay/solver-resolved), with isProTrader/isSniper badges on every row and isWash on Solana. On Base, preconfirmed (flashblocks) trades appear ~2.5s before block commit, flagged per row. Rich filters (side, USD/native/token size, date range, makers) and opaque cursor pagination.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58, case-sensitive).

parameters.name: pools
parameters.description: Optional. CSV of pool addresses (≤50) restricting the scope. Omit for the token-wide default (every pool of the token). Each pool listed must belong to the token.

parameters.name: usdMin
parameters.description: Keep trades whose USD volume is at least this.

parameters.name: usdMax
parameters.description: Keep trades whose USD volume is at most this.

parameters.name: nativeMin
parameters.description: Keep trades whose native-quote volume is at least this.

parameters.name: nativeMax
parameters.description: Keep trades whose native-quote volume is at most this.

parameters.name: tokenAmountMin
parameters.description: Keep trades of at least this many tokens.

parameters.name: tokenAmountMax
parameters.description: Keep trades of at most this many tokens.

parameters.name: fromAt
parameters.description: Only trades at/after this time (epoch ms, inclusive).

parameters.name: toAt
parameters.description: Only trades at/before this time (epoch ms, inclusive).

parameters.name: washFilter
parameters.description: `washOnly` or `organicOnly` - filter by the per-transaction wash badge (Solana; every row carries `isWash`).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque - pass `meta.nextCursor` back verbatim to page.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: CSV opt-ins. `traderTxCounts` adds each row's `makerTxCount` (that trader's tx count within the page's time window).

makers.description: POST only. Filter to these trader addresses (up to 2000).

get.description: Every position a wallet has fully exited: total bought and sold (USD and native), realized PnL in absolute and percent, buy/sell counts and last trade time. The realized counterpart of `/v1/wallet/positions` - every position of a wallet lands in exactly one of the two. EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id - `evm:<id>` or `solana`. Omit to infer from the address: a `0x` wallet returns every EVM chain, a base58 wallet returns Solana.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip for pagination. Default 0.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `lastTradeAt` (default, newest exit first) or `pnl` (largest realized PnL first).

get.description: Total wallet value (USD) as a time series over a chosen window - the equity curve behind every portfolio chart.

Where a wallet got its first funds: the earliest native transfer that funded it - funder address, timestamp, transaction and amount, with an entity tag (exchange, bridge…) when the funder is known. The primitive behind insider and sybil heuristics.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

get.description: Realized PnL of a wallet: daily curve plus summary (total realized, win rate, trades, wins/losses). Omit `chain` to combine every EVM chain; `chain=solana` for Solana.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id. Omit for all EVM chains combined.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: `1d`, `7d`, `30d` (default) or `all`. On EVM `all` spans the wallet's full history.

get.description: Every position of a wallet with entry price and PnL: amount held, USD value, average entry, realized + unrealized + total PnL, trade counts and first/last trade timestamps. EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Public chain id - `evm:<id>` or `solana`. Omit to infer from the address: a `0x` wallet returns every EVM chain, a base58 wallet returns Solana.

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Comma-separated token addresses (1-50) to scope the response to - positions and summary cover only those tokens. Same shape, faster: the lookup narrows to the requested tokens.

post.description: Batch twin: up to 100 addresses per call, response array in input order, `null` slots for wallets without a known identity (identities are harvested continuously - retry later, never assume permanent).

items.description: `[{ "address": "…" }]` - 1 to 100 items, EVM and Solana mixed freely.

get.description: Who is behind an address: display name, avatar, ENS / Basename / .sol, bio, social accounts (Twitter, Farcaster, GitHub…), follower counts, sources, pro-trader flag - plus `linkedWallets`, other addresses of the same person (cross-wallet identity clusters). Built on our identity graph of 7.6M+ labeled wallets across EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex or Solana base58).

get.description: Trade history of a wallet, newest first - multihop-deduplicated (one event per transaction, token and side; never doubled volumes). Paginate with the opaque `cursor` from `meta.nextCursor` on both EVM and Solana: exact keyset pagination that never skips or repeats a trade. Routed intermediate legs (the wSOL or stable a route passes through) are excluded by default and flagged `isRoutingHop`; on Solana pass `includeRoutingHops=true` to include them. Wash/MEV rows are kept and carry the `isWash` badge (Solana) so consumers choose.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Wallet address (EVM hex, case-insensitive; Solana base58).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque resume token from `meta.nextCursor` - exact keyset pagination, no skip or duplicate. Works on both EVM and Solana.

parameters.name: beforeAt
parameters.description: Upper time bound (ms): only trades strictly older. Prefer `cursor` for exact paging.

parameters.name: includeRoutingHops
parameters.description: Solana only. Also serve the intermediate legs of routed swaps. Default false.

get.description: Token in/out history of a wallet: deposits, withdrawals, plain transfers - timestamp (ms), token, amount, direction, counterparty, tx hash. The reconciliation primitive next to `/v1/wallet/trades`.
